init._doc: image settings for `init`. The image worker runs under `python` (needs Pillow + OpenCV); sd-scripts' venv has both.
init.caption: {trigger} {class}

stage._doc: kohya dataset settings for `stage`. repeats = ceil(steps_per_epoch / images), capped at max_repeats; `--repeats` overrides. epochs mirrors train_lora.sh --max_train_epochs, for the step estimate only.

train._doc: settings for `train`, which runs `script` (train_lora.sh). lora_dir must match the script's OUT (Forge's LoRA folder). sec_per_step is the estimate until a run on the profile measures one.

keys._doc: --keys mapping. A key listed here fills a typed profile field; any other key goes to profile.attributes unchanged. Keys match case-insensitively.

terms.voiceType: no benchmark; assumption: free-text voice classification (Tenor, Baritone, ...)
terms.trigger: no benchmark; assumption: kohya/DreamBooth instance token
